sources.author: Hatem Zaag

sources.version: Author PDF dated 10 October 2006, 67 PDF pages; front matter identifies JFA 253 (2007), 43-121

sources.not_read: The long modulation, compactness and spectral proofs in later sections have not been fully read. Screenshot calls returned no viewable pixels, so no visual PDF inspection is claimed.

sources.checked: Exact comparison centers versus modulated centers with o(1) error; fixed k>=2; alternating signs; correct original-variable numerator in (21); solution-dependent center shift; local versus global claims about characteristic points.
sources.not_read: Full PDE construction and topological shooting proof not read. Pinned local v1 PDF was subsequently independently read; see the separate v1 source record. Deep proofs remain external.

sources.read: Introduction, complete Theorem 1 parts A-C and remarks; section 2.1 through Lemma 2.2 and its proof sketch, ending at (2.16).

sources.not_read: The later modulation dynamics, sections 3-4 and appendices are not fully read. Pinned local v1 PDF was subsequently independently read; see the separate v1 source record. Deep proofs remain external.

sources.version: Pinned arXiv v1 watermark 18 October 2016; internal PDF date 16 November 2018.
sources.read: Independently extracted and read PDF pages 1-8 in full: complete Theorem 1 and remarks, construction roadmap, generalized solitons (2.1)-(2.2), Proposition 2.1, linearized operator/eigenfunctions (2.6)-(2.10).
sources.checked: N=2 and 1<p<5, H1xL2 data, local singleton characteristic set, two distinct error scales, bisector subsequence only; correct positive-log negative-mu singular time.

source_level_checks.conclusion: The equation is the focusing scalar NLW u_tt=Delta u+|u|^(p-1)u. For N>=2, p_c=(N+3)/(N-1)=1+4/(N-1), while p_S=(N+2)/(N-2) for N>=3. For N=1, p_c=infinity and every finite p>1 is subconformal. The complete real-valued single/multisoliton classification is one-dimensional; higher-dimensional radial extensions exclude the origin. General higher-dimensional classification is not proved.
source_level_checks.status: Compared with every frozen topic page; see page_checks and open findings.

source_level_checks.conclusion: Use the maximal influence domain t<T(x) with 1-Lipschitz T. Noncharacteristic means extension in a cone wider than the unit light cone, with delta<1, not merely a pointwise condition on an already-defined derivative. In one dimension R is nonempty and open, T is C1 on R and T'(a)=d(a). S consists of isolated points; this is not a higher-dimensional statement.
source_level_checks.status: Compared with every frozen topic page; see page_checks and open findings.

source_level_checks.conclusion: Set tau=T(a)-t, y=(x-a)/tau, s=-log tau and w=tau^(2/(p-1))u. alpha=2/(p-1)-(N-1)/2. Subconformal dissipation is -2alpha integral w_s^2 rho/(1-|y|^2); at alpha=0 there is a boundary flux, not zero dissipation obtained by naive substitution. The spatial energy quadratic form must be one half of |grad w|^2-(y.grad w)^2.
source_level_checks.status: Compared with every frozen topic page; see page_checks and open findings.

source_level_checks.conclusion: Noncharacteristic profiles have one signed kappa(d). Characteristic profiles have a fixed integer k(a)>=2, alternating signs up to a common sign, and d_i=-tanh zeta_i. The leading zeta_i coefficient is (i-(k+1)/2)(p-1)/2 times log s. The common center shift is solution-dependent. When k is odd the middle soliton need not escape to the light-cone boundary. Similarity profiles are not constant-speed travelling waves of the original equation.
source_level_checks.status: Compared with every frozen topic page; see page_checks and open findings.

source_level_checks.conclusion: The physical cone-supremum rate is tau^(-2/(p-1)) at R and tau^(-2/(p-1))*|log tau|^((k-1)/2) at S. The graph corner correction is comparable to |x-a|/|log|x-a||^((k-1)(p-1)/2), with left slope +1 and right slope -1. Soliton-center separation is order log s=log|log tau|. Neither the physical supremum nor the spatial corner exponent may be substituted for the other. Bounds should be stated near blow-up rather than at all initial times when the logarithm could vanish.
source_level_checks.status: Compared with every frozen topic page; see page_checks and open findings.

source_level_checks.conclusion: The constructed 2D solution has four axial solitons with neighboring opposite signs. The origin is locally the sole characteristic point. On bisectors away from zero, points are noncharacteristic but only subsequential convergence to a genuinely 2D stationary solution is stated; C1 regularity is asserted outside bisectors. The 3-step construction is a proof strategy invoking the original research, not a complete local proof. The subconformal restriction for this construction must be explicit.
source_level_checks.status: Compared with every frozen topic page; see page_checks and open findings.

source_discrepancies.observation: Displays 1/2|grad w|^2-(y.grad w)^2 rather than 1/2[|grad w|^2-(y.grad w)^2].
source_discrepancies.independent_check: For L=rho^(-1)div(rho(I-y tensor y)grad), the quadratic energy is 1/2 integral grad w.(I-y tensor y)grad w rho. The displayed missing factor would not cancel the L term against w_s.
source_discrepancies.required_action: Use the correct quadratic form if importing energy; record the derivation/source clarification. This is a reviewer calculation, not an official erratum.

source_discrepancies.observation: Displays (T(a)-t)^(-1/(p-1)) in the numerator of the original-variable profile.
source_discrepancies.independent_check: Substitution of (3.10) into (3.2) gives numerator (1-d(a)^2)^(1/(p-1)); all powers of tau outside the denominator cancel. At d=0 the printed numerator already contradicts the ODE exponent.
source_discrepancies.required_action: Derive the original-variable formula instead of copying (3.17).

source_discrepancies.observation: (3.16) uses k(s) although the theorem fixes k(a); (3.19) writes log(x-a), undefined on the negative side over the reals.
source_discrepancies.required_action: Keep fixed k(a) and use log|x-a| with absolute value around the logarithm as appropriate.

source_discrepancies.observation: The displayed all-t interval allows tau=1, where the logarithmic upper bound vanishes.
source_discrepancies.required_action: State the asymptotic estimate for t sufficiently near T(a), or use a separately justified regularized logarithm.

source_discrepancies.location: Published section 3.3 and report-v1 generalized-soliton discussion
source_discrepancies.observation: The negative-mu singular-time expression has a minus sign before log.
source_discrepancies.independent_check: For denominator 1+mu*exp(s)+d.y on |y|<1, the boundary threshold is 1+mu*exp(s)-|d|=0. Thus s=log((|d|-1)/mu), without a leading minus. This agrees with the paragraph after (2.2) in MZ-1610.05637v2.
source_discrepancies.required_action: Use the algebraically consistent positive-log expression if this time is stated. Do not present this observation as an official erratum.

structural_checks.method: Independent read-only ID/title/body-link/hash checks and DFS against shared prerequisite registry merged with packet.
structural_checks.limits: Structural closure does not rereview the mathematics of all 175 pre-existing nodes. All 13 direct reused pages were read. No build/render/release validation was performed.

page_checks.checks: One-dimensional complete classification versus special two-dimensional construction distinguished; no global finiteness assertion for S. Revised overview correctly retains the odd-k central exception (Z-F3 resolved).

pc=1+4/(N-1), pS=1+4/(N-2), N=1 conventions and N=2/3 examples checked. Finite-energy theory is now explicitly limited through the conformal endpoint; uniformly local theory to strict subconformal. Arbitrary-p algebra is separated (Z-F1 resolved).
u_lambda amplitude exponent 2/(p-1) from matching derivative/nonlinearity powers checked; scaling alone is not a theorem on every blow-up rate.
ODE kappa0 tau^-2/(p-1) and sign invariance checked. Finite-speed cutoff explains local realization without claiming spatially constant data have finite global energy.
Shrinking-ball difference energy, nonpositive flux, bounded-solution nonlinear Lipschitz constant and exponential integrating factor checked. Rough-energy extension is cited, not proved.
Maximal influence domain is an input of local theory; cone inclusion gives both Lipschitz inequalities. Does not identify a characteristic point merely by differentiability.
Wider cone has delta<1 and starts at t0<T(a). C1 graph with norm of gradient<1 is sufficient locally; no unsupported converse.
tau, y, s, w normalization and all chain-rule terms checked, including coefficient (p+3)/(p-1), transport -2y.grad ws, alpha and degenerate divergence operator.
Correct half of the entire gradient quadratic form, alpha>0 weighted phase norm and nonlinear integrability condition checked; scalar energy and phase norm distinguished.
Integration by parts gives -2alpha integral ws^2 rho/(1-|y|^2); transport coefficient checked. Monotonicity alone is not orbit convergence.

Polar radial concentration yields boundary measure with correct factor 2alpha; uniform continuity controls the shell. Conformal E0 is separately defined, boundary flux computed directly, not inferred from varying-parameter solution convergence.
Noncharacteristic near-blow-up two-sided bounds and L2 volume factor tau^(N/2) checked; time/spatial derivatives have one extra inverse tau; conformal endpoint not confused with strict dissipation.
Original-variable numerator (1-|d|^2)^(1/(p-1)), positive denominator domain and stationary kappa checked by substitution. Weighted-space assertions restricted to alpha>0.
y=tanh xi and d=-tanh zeta produce translated cosh pulse with correct sign and powers.
N=1 H0 stationary set {0,plus/minus kappa(d)} compared with JFA Proposition 1 and full section 2.3. Local outline does not disguise weighted compactness/ODE classification as a complete new proof.
N=1,p>1; phase-space exponential convergence and ordinary H1xL2 convergence kept distinct. Unique sign/parameter and noncharacteristic hypothesis checked.

Finite fixed k(a)>=2, alternating signs times one common sign, phase pair, exact comparison centers versus actual o(1)-corrected modulation centers and energy quantization checked. PDE applications now fix A=c1(p) from the external modulation theorem (Z-F2 resolved).

b_i=(p-1)i(k-i)/(4A), zero endpoint interactions, zero-center normalization and conserved center checked. Uniqueness is only within the stated logarithmic ansatz. PDE application now fixes A=c1(p); the independent change-of-A calculation confirms it is not a common shift (Z-F2 resolved).
tanh tail produces power in s; odd-k central center remains at finite zeta; all physical centers still converge to a as tau shrinks.
R nonempty/open, T C1 on R, T'=d, sign constant on connected components checked. Geometric rigidity is not replaced by formally matching leading terms.
S is isolated and locally finite, not globally finite. Two-sided log absolute values, exponent (k-1)(p-1)/2 and left/right slopes +1/-1 checked.
Two state components, nu=mu exp(s), denominator positivity, s*=log((1-|d|)/|mu|), mu signs and alpha>0 H decay checked.

Same physical spacetime point gives amplitude ratio and translated y; generalized mu expression checked. Comparison plane solution is distinguished from original u; mu=0 for its own actual blow-up graph.
Oddness persists by uniqueness; closed odd subspace cannot converge to a fixed-sign kappa. Finite propagation plateau example gives finite-time blow-up and makes T(0) finite via Lipschitz graph.

Prescribed k>=2, location and center in uniformly local energy class checked against exact v1 Theorem 3. Does not prescribe global S={a}. PDE comparison centers now use the fixed c1(p) (Z-F2 resolved).
Radial perturbation coefficient exp(-s)/(r0+exp(-s)y), r0>0 and radial p<=pc checked; origin excluded. Transfer of classification remains external.
Strict subconformal range; R0 requires existing single-soliton H convergence. Openness/C1/gradient and uniformly local initial-data stability checked in pinned v1 Theorems 1-2.
N=2,1<p<5, four axial profiles with opposite neighboring signs, phase-pair H convergence and local S intersection ball={0} verified against v1.
Distinct x1 log^(-(p-1)/2) and x2 log^(-(p-1)/4) errors retained; symmetry/continuity gives first-order max norm pyramid.

Nonzero bisector points noncharacteristic; only subsequence convergence to a genuinely two-dimensional stationary solution. Antisymmetry rules out signed positive kappa but does not itself establish existence/nonzero limit.
Three construction stages accurately described; spectral/modulation/topological/moving-cone estimates remain research-paper inputs, not a complete proof.
General higher-dimensional classification, conformal and superconformal regimes separated. Cubic N=3 is conformal; odd p>=7 is supercritical, not strict subconformal evidence.
Heat similarity scaling 1/(p-1), drift -y.grad/2, Gaussian weight and squared ws dissipation checked under explicit growth/integration assumptions.
Differentiating exact families gives lambda1 time mode and lambda0 parameter modes; no full spectral classification, closed-operator realization or stability theorem inferred.
Near-blow-up cone supremum tau^-2/(p-1) times |log tau|^((k-1)/2) at S checked. Outer-soliton calculation is illustrative; H convergence alone does not imply L-infinity asymptotics.
Stationary multiplier identity, positive energy constant, Mobius change of variable, invariance in d and global sign checked.
Lorentz inverse and wave-operator cross-term cancellation checked, with transformed domain retained.
DOI/published metadata/license and exact supplementary theorem versions read. Pinned v1 internal date discrepancies recorded rather than silently treated as newer arXiv versions.

semantic_decisions.decision: Local finiteness/isolation of S is distinct from finite soliton number per characteristic point. The frozen atoms preserve this distinction; no global finiteness correction needed.
Uniformly local data stability verified directly in pinned v1 Theorem 2; not a finding.

Example/construction/proof-outline atoms answer distinct local questions. Deep cited inputs are explicitly marked, so their lack of reconstructed research proofs is a declared boundary, not proof completion.

reviewed_files_schema: Only individually read tree files with repository-relative paths. Packet digest is separate; all three recorded findings were resolved before pass.

resolved_findings.title: Restrict the energy-space local well-posedness assertion
resolved_findings.detail: The page begins with arbitrary N>=1 and p>1, then unconditionally asserts local existence, uniqueness and continuous dependence for the stated H1 x L2 or uniformly local energy data. This cannot be imported for arbitrary energy-supercritical p.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Explicitly restrict the invoked local theory to the subconformal range and any separately justified conformal endpoint needed here. Distinguish algebraic formulas valid for arbitrary p>1 from the range of this energy-space Cauchy theorem; update the packet proof scope.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reread 4901 in full. Finite-energy theory is restricted to N=1,p>1 or N>=2,1<p<=pc, with report section 3 supporting the conformal endpoint; uniformly local theory is separately restricted to strict subconformal range and pinned 1309.7760v1 p1. Algebraic arbitrary-p identities are explicitly distinguished. Revised packet scopes agree.

resolved_findings.title: Fix the PDE interaction coefficient in the Toda comparison centers
resolved_findings.detail: 4911 proves a family of logarithmic solutions for arbitrary A>0. The PDE approximation in 4910 and construction in 4918 must use A=c1(p), the fixed positive coefficient inherited from the modulation theorem. Changing A alters relative constant shifts and is not absorbed by the common center zeta_*.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Specify A=c1(p)>0 when applying the Toda atom to the PDE, with source CZ-v1 (16), (28), (31). Its numerical formula need not be rederived; its external status must remain explicit. Refresh packet descriptions and hashes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reread 4910,4911,4918 in full and compare pinned CZ-v1 (16),(28),(31). PDE applications fix A=c1(p)>0 as an external modulation coefficient. The standalone ODE calculation still permits arbitrary fixed A. Independently checked adjacent-constant change +(p-1)log(A'/A)/2, which cannot be absorbed into a common translation.

resolved_findings.title: Retain the central-soliton exception in the overview
resolved_findings.detail: The overview says adjacent centers separate and gradually approach the cone boundary without qualification. When k is odd, the middle zeta has zero logarithmic coefficient and its y-center stays in the interior, as 4912 correctly explains.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Say the outer/noncentral centers approach the boundary, explicitly retaining the odd-k central exception or referring to 4912 with an accurate qualified label.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reread 4900 in full. It now specifies noncentral similarity-space centers approach the cone boundary and the odd-k middle center stays interior, consistently with 4912.
